rules.source: AVG art. 5 lid 1 sub e (opslagbeperking); Autoriteit Persoonsgegevens richtlijn sollicitatiegegevens; UAVG (https://wetten.overheid.nl/BWBR0040940)
rules.statement: A rejected Application shall carry rejectedDate and retentionExpiryDate = rejectedDate + 4 weken zonder talent-pool-toestemming, of + 1 jaar met talentPoolOptIn; on afgewezen neither field may be null.

rules.source: AVG art. 5 lid 1 sub e (opslagbeperking); Autoriteit Persoonsgegevens richtlijn sollicitatiegegevens; UAVG (https://wetten.overheid.nl/BWBR0040940)
rules.statement: An Application whose retentionExpiryDate lies in the past shall no longer exist un-anonymised in the register; one still present at audit time is in violation.

rules.source: AVG art. 5 lid 1 sub e (opslagbeperking) -- read against OpenRegister's own computed retention.archiefactiedatum (RetentionService), never a bespoke humaniq field (hrmq#99).
rules.statement: A payroll/loonadministratie record (Payslip, PayrollRun, LoonaangifteFiling, PayrollMutationReport, WkrDeclaration, WkrAssessment, PensionFiling) or a GeneratedDocument whose OpenRegister retention.archiefactiedatum lies in the past shall not still exist un-destroyed (archiefstatus other than vernietigd) at audit time; a recommended-severity flag only -- no automated destruction runs from this check.
